origin.description: Combine skewness and kurtosis into one chi-square test of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector. A matrix is rejected, and missing values are not dropped.

origin.details: JB is n/6 times the squared skewness plus one quarter of the squared distance of the kurtosis from 3. The p-value is the upper tail of chi-square with 2 degrees of freedom. The alternative string is the word greater.
origin.value: An htest with the statistic JB and the p-value.
